# Overview

| | |
|---|---|
| **Template** | `MINIO_Vendor_Template_10192026.xlsx` from SOA: 61 columns, tabs Field Restrictions, Vendor Template, Vendor Category |
| **Required** | Company Name (marked red). First and Last Name are required instead when the vendor is an individual |
| **Sources** | Ramp vendor export, 578 vendors, synced to NetSuite by Ramp. Sage Intacct vendor detail export, 1,770 active vendors. 551 Ramp vendors carry the Sage vendor ID, so the link is exact |
| **Bank details** | Not in the template: a separate import, Ramp's details first, else Sage's |
| **Vendor load document** | The table of every vendor, with the breakdown, load plan, bank details and open questions in its Notes: https://claude.ai/artifact/43aBdfBgsyuiGNHAtGPSsw |
